Implement the following feature request in this repository (oneDAL). `bazel` is on PATH. This machine is CPU-only and has no oneAPI DPC++ compiler (`icpx`), so only the host (`*_host`) Bazel test targets can be built and run here. Do not weaken or delete existing tests.

# [Feature] covariance: add a `bias` option to choose the 1/N (biased) covariance estimator

### Motivation

`oneapi::dal::covariance` always returns the unbiased sample covariance, normalized by `1/(N-1)`. scikit-learn-intelex needs the maximum-likelihood (biased) estimator normalized by `1/N` as well (`sklearn.covariance.EmpiricalCovariance`, `numpy.cov(..., bias=True)`). Rescaling the result on the Python side is wrong for correlation outputs and in the online/distributed flows, so the option has to exist in the library itself, the same way `assume_centered` already does.

### Requested API

On `oneapi::dal::covariance::descriptor<Float, Method, Task>` (and its `detail::descriptor_base<Task>`), following exactly the pattern of the existing `assume_centered` property:

```cpp
bool get_bias() const;                 // default: false
auto& set_bias(const bool& value);     // returns *this, chainable
```

Semantics:
- `bias == false` (default): current behaviour, covariance normalized by `1/(N-1)`.
- `bias == true`: covariance normalized by `1/N`, where N is the total number of observations (for online compute, the number of rows accumulated over all `partial_compute` calls).
- `means` are unaffected. The correlation matrix is unaffected by the choice.
- Must work for batch `compute` and for online `partial_compute` + `finalize_compute`, in combination with `assume_centered` and every `result_options` value.

### Implementation requirements

The CPU path of oneDAL covariance is implemented on top of the DAAL covariance kernels, so the option has to be plumbed all the way down: the DAAL `daal::algorithms::covariance::Parameter` struct should get a new public field `bool bias = false;` (next to `assumeCentered`) that makes the DAAL covariance finalization use `1/N` instead of `1/(N-1)`, and the oneDAL CPU backend must set it from `desc.get_bias()` for both batch and online (finalize) compute. Do not implement it by rescaling results in the oneAPI layer.

GPU (DPC++) kernels do not need to implement the option in this change (they cannot be built on this machine), but do not remove or break GPU code.

### Acceptance

The existing covariance host test suites keep passing, and new tests that construct e.g.

```cpp
covariance::descriptor<Float, Method, covariance::task::compute>()
    .set_result_options(result_option)
    .set_assume_centered(assume_centered)
    .set_bias(bias);
```

and compare against a `1/N` (bias) or `1/(N-1)` reference pass in `//cpp/oneapi/dal/algo/covariance:test_batch_host`, `test_online_host` and `test_compute_parameters_host`.
